# T-1: Define artifact validator

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create deterministic validation for flow-level gate-impl (phase=integration) trust inputs and return auditable failure reasons for missing, malformed, stale, and placeholder artifacts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Validator accepts the valid artifact set named in R1.
- Validator rejects every invalid class named in R2 and R3 with ARTIFACT_PLACEHOLDER.
- Validator keeps existing v2 test-result and regression stale checks from R4.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a class-based representation for required artifacts and validation results if new structured values are introduced. Reuse existing functions in test-artifacts.js and req-map.js before adding new logic.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for valid artifacts, missing files, malformed JSON, empty summary, raw output mismatch, unknown requirement ids, placeholder sentinels, and placeholder fixture hash.
